articles.headline: Lionel Messi becomes the first man to start in three World Cup finals
articles.description: Lionel Messi has officially become the oldest outfield player to ever take the field in a World Cup final, after starting for Argentina as they take on Spain.

articles.headline: World Cup final LIVE: Spain, Argentina face off in New Jersey
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the World Cup as Spain and Lamine Yamal take on Argentina and Lionel Messi in the final.

articles.headline: Harry Kane warns England are 'still in that grieving stage' but strongly backs Thomas Tuchel
articles.description: Harry Kane admitted England will be "grieving" their World Cup heartbreak for some time to come although he backed Thomas Tuchel to stay on as head coach.

articles.headline: What changes has Argentina made for the Final against Spain?
articles.description: What changes has Argentina made for the Final against Spain?

articles.headline: Argentina make 3 changes to World Cup final lineup vs. Spain
articles.description: Argentina have made three changes to the starting lineup for the 2026 World Cup final against Spain, with Rodrigo De Paul, Nico González and Gonzalo Montiel set to kick off for the defending champions.

articles.headline: Spain World Cup champ Capdevila gets into U.S. for final
articles.description: Former Spain defender Joan Capdevila has made it to the United States to watch the World Cup final after being denied authorization to travel a decade after playing in an exhibition game in Iran.
